title: Visual Line Mode (V)
instruction_text:
Select entire lines at once!

'V' = enter visual line mode (capital V)
'j/k' = select more lines
'd' = delete selected lines

Your task: Delete the two 'Delete' lines.

Steps:
1. Move cursor to 'Delete line A'
2. Press 'V' (capital V) to enter visual line mode
3. Press 'j' to extend selection to include 'Delete line B'
4. Press 'd' to delete both lines
5. Save and quit with :wq
setup_file:
Keep line 1
Delete line A
Delete line B
Keep line 2
